source_text: Three randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in Africa—ANRS 1265 (South Africa, 2005), and studies in Kenya (Bailey et al., 2007) and Uganda (Gray et al., 2007)—demonstrated that adult male circumcision reduces heterosexual HIV acquisition by 50-60% over 24-30 months follow-up, with hazard ratios ranging from 0.40 to 0.47. [36]
